en: {rival}
Team Plasma! Wherever you go, I won't let you get away!
With a roar of engines, the Plasma Frigate rose from the water and flew off toward the west...
{rival}
...It flies?! Where's it going?
Cheren
Sorry I'm late. If I had to guess, they're making for the Giant Chasm.
{rival}
The Giant Chasm! That's at the far end of Route 22, right? Then that's where I'm going!
That Pokémon in the ship... Kyurem. Its cry sounded so lonely.
Cheren
Kyurem! So Team Plasma means to use Kyurem's power for themselves.
{rival}
How do we stop something like that? Drayden said only Reshiram or Zekrom could stand up to it. And neither of them is anywhere!
...It doesn't matter. I'm going. {player}, follow when you're ready!
{rival}
{player}! You found them! I knew you could do it!
That's Team Plasma's ship, anchored right off the beach. But... how do we get aboard?
Marlon
Hold up!
Eh, this should do it!
A heavy gangplank came down from the ship's rail with a solid thud...
{rival}
Marlon! I thought you didn't care about Team Plasma?
Marlon
Hey, friends! Team Plasma's not bothering me. They might be up to no good for real, but it's not my style to decide that without thinking it through.
But you're in trouble, so I've got to help. That's what I want to do!
{rival}
...Thanks.
Marlon
Listen, 'K? Believe in something. Searching for a stolen Pokémon is fine. Keeping Unova from freezing is fine too. Just think about why you're doing it.
I made a bit of noise, so some of them are bound to come out. Be careful, 'K!
{rival}
What was that?! The guy doesn't stick around, does he?
Well... I guess he was being kind in his own way. All right, I'm going in!
{rival}
Let's go! Team Plasma isn't getting away this time!
Cheren
You can reach the Giant Chasm from Route 22. Be ready before you go, {player}.
